confidence_notes: Restaurant and drink anchors are medium confidence. They rest on a secondary report of Numbeo-style rankings, a cost-of-living tool dated January 2026, and an undated Expatistan cocktail data point, cross-checked against general knowledge. Dorm anchors use a BudgetYourTrip average and Hostelz monthly averages, adjusted for July as a low season. The hotel_3star_2p anchor is the least certain. The HotelsCombined range of $329-475 looked high and internally inconsistent, and an undated Amimir double-room average of $127 pointed lower, so the value is a judgement-based figure. Cocktail and wine were set from the local price relationship to beer where direct data was weak. The FX observation (0.7088, dated 2026-03-20) was read from a cached RBA exchange-rates page snippet. I could not retrieve the current daily table, so it may not be the latest published rate for 2026-10-16.
comparable_city_reasoning: No comparable city was used. Estimates are Cape Town-specific, drawn from aggregated price sources and general knowledge, and pitched to July (austral winter, low tourist season).
